analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Apprenticeship starts, participation and achievements provide different views of provider activity and should be considered together.
The provider landscape is large, so quality, occupational specialism and employer relationships are important differentiators.
Growth and Skills Levy reforms can shift the mix of funded provision and create new workforce and partnership requirements.

latestUpdates.title: Growth and Skills Levy reforms
latestUpdates.summary: Growth and Skills Levy reforms apply to the 2026/27 apprenticeship system, including foundation apprenticeships and new flexible products. The official reforms factsheet describes the reforms as backed by £1 billion in additional investment; CareerPath records that as policy context rather than a provider allocation.

latestUpdates.title: Apprenticeships July 2026 performance update
latestUpdates.summary: Official provisional apprenticeship statistics covering August 2025 to April 2026 were published for England.
